g1.label: 1. Why research the company?
g1.why: The text says researching the company shows you are genuinely interested in working there.

g2.label: 2. Talking about a weakness?
g2.why: The text says to always explain what you are doing to improve a weakness.

g3.label: 3. Body language to avoid?
g3.why: The text says to avoid crossing your arms, as it can look closed off.

g4.label: 4. How to dress?
g4.why: The text says it's better to be slightly overdressed than underdressed.

g5.label: 5. Why prepare questions?
g5.why: The text says asking thoughtful questions shows you are engaged and serious about the role.

g6.label: 6. Good closing question?
g6.why: The text gives this as an example of a good question to ask the interviewer.

g1.label: 1. One of my main ___
g1.why: ‘Strengths’ is the standard word for positive qualities in an interview context.

g2.label: 2. Your previous work ___?
g2.why: ‘Work experience’ is the standard collocation for past jobs.

g3.label: 3. I would like to ___
g3.why: ‘Apply for’ is the standard verb for a job position.

g4.label: 4. Opportunities for career ___
g4.why: ‘Career development’ is the standard collocation, not ‘career change/movement’ here.

g5.label: 5. We are looking for a ___
g5.why: ‘Candidate’ is the standard word for a job applicant.

g6.label: 6. Send a follow-up email to ___
g6.why: Thanking the interviewer is standard professional follow-up etiquette.

g7.label: 7. A good first ___
g7.why: ‘First impression’ is the standard fixed phrase.

g8.label: 8. CV and a cover ___
g8.why: ‘Cover letter’ is the standard term for the document sent with a CV.

g1.label: 1. "Tell me about yourself."
g1.why: A professional summary of qualifications and experience is the appropriate response.

g2.label: 2. "What is your greatest weakness?"
g2.why: An honest weakness paired with how you're improving it is the professional approach.

g3.label: 3. "Why do you want to work for our company?"
g3.why: A specific, researched reason tied to your skills is the appropriate response.

g4.label: 4. "Where do you see yourself in five years?"
g4.why: A realistic answer about growth within the company is the appropriate response.

g5.label: 5. "Do you have any questions for us?"
g5.why: A thoughtful question about the role or team is the appropriate response.

g6.label: 6. "Why did you leave your last job?"
g6.why: A positive, professional reason is the appropriate response.
